decisionRule: Only permanent player mount actions retained by the canonical SkillLine 777 review may be journal actions. Visibility never grants ownership.
notes: Spell 64731 is the aquatic Sea Turtle and remains availability-checked by the server.
Spell 75973 is the two-seat X-53 Touring Rocket; ezCollections mountType 3 is flying even though the legacy action evidence lacks a flying speed row.
The three TAXI spells were rejected before canonical identity generation because they are not player mount SkillLine 777 actions.
